title: Introducing the Claude apps gateway for Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud
translatedTitle: 面向 Amazon Bedrock 和 Google Cloud 的 Claude apps gateway 正式发布
subtitle: Connect Claude Code to Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud with the new Claude apps gateway: corporate SSO login, centrally enforced policy, role-based access, per-user cost attribution, and spend caps—all from one stateless container on your infrastructure.
